facts.fact: The Bank of Mauritius launched BOMStats, its statistical data platform at https://bomstats.bom.mu, on 3 September 2026, giving access to the Bank's official statistics with self-service analytics, an API and SDMX-format data sharing; the release gives no dataset count and no licence.
